name: Secret of Evermore (USA)
what: Where Open Evermore finds and rewrites each table in this release, and where each kind may be placed (docs/open-evermore/mapping.md). Addresses as the game uses them; the evidence is in each codec's header and in docs/open-evermore/resources.md.

strings.why: a string key holds 15 bits of address in a bank's lower half and 8 bits of bank above $C0; the decoder steps a 16-bit pointer (strings.mts)

texts.why: menu texts are read through 16-bit pointers and printed by $8C:9E03 with bank #$C4 (texts.mts)

scripts.why: a packed script pointer is a position in the upper halves of $92-$BF; the program counter steps from $xx:FFFF on to $xx+1:8000 (docs/scripts/vm.md)

maps.why: a room is read in the $80-$BF form inside one bank, into a 32 KiB buffer (maps.mts)

tiles.why: the loader and the streamer read a tile by DMA, whose source stays in its bank (tiles.mts)

palettes.why: palette n is read at base + 32·n with a 16-bit address in one bank half (palettes.mts)

sprite_blocks.why: a block's bank is the table's base bank + 7 bits; codecs add the base (sprite-blocks.mts)

metasprites.why: animation scripts and records hold metasprite pointers into these banks (metasprites.mts)

music.why: a package in the $80-$BF form; a read that ends on a bank's last byte turns the bank and costs cycles vanilla never spent (progress.md §2)

music/lower.why: a package vanilla keeps in a lower half: the same reader, $C0-$FF form

music/window.why: a package that runs on from one bank's upper half into the next one's

characters.why: code and saves keep a record by its 16-bit address ($xx:B678 + 74·k): only the bank moves, read by mvn (characters.mts)

animation_records.why: animate() reads its records with 16-bit pointers in bank $C4 (animations.mts)

animation_scripts.why: the animation VM steps a 16-bit pointer; jumps between scripts stay in their bank (animations.mts)

grown_tables.why: a grown table or hook is reached by a long operand implode writes in the $80/$C0 form (items.mts, ingredients.mts)

direct_page.why: read with 1-byte direct-page operands (the engine runs with D = $0000; wram.md W3 suspects code with another D)
parts: the direct page: the engine's scratch registers (D = 0)

low.why: read with 16-bit absolute operands from the code banks ($80-$BF), which reach WRAM only through its low mirror $0000-$1FFF

room metatile bits, camera limits, viewport collision rows
the Boy's and Dog's stats, equipment, purses, alchemy selection, weapon levels (save block $0ABA)
controls, save menu, font, stamina, audio volume, shop and dialogue state
the ring shop, armour, bazooka, call and alchemy menus
the APU state: music, sound effects, transfers
demo abort, NMI enable, shop mode, flight, transitions, window frame
script VM and animation script state, entity scheduler, attack and damage, room hooks, entity ticks, spawns
camera, DMA, the Boy's entity pointer, viewport, ring debug buffer, map header, room tables, minimap, grass swap
room steps, animated tiles, entity batches, terrain timers, single VRAM uploads
music id, sprite slots, palette slots, the sprite VRAM cache, CGRAM DMA, palette animation
animation frame, talk, OAM high, the Dog's sprite and form, companion, the Boy's idle, bazooka

system.why: past the low mirror: absolute operands with the data bank $7E (pea $7E7E / plb), or long ones; the names ($2210, $2234) end it

save.why: from the save block at $2258 to temp[]: saved blocks and the script save area (save-system.md, growable-items.md); a save from one layout does not load in another (W8)
parts: learned formulas, story flags, charms (saved $2258-$22E9), room transition state
ingredient, consumable and armour counts, ammo (saved $22FF-$235A), Dog AI
the Dog's form, script state (saved $2361-$238C), camera, cutscenes, spawns
event counters (saved $2513-$2532), shop and peddler state, the unused rest

temp.why: the compiler's temp[], wiped on every room load

room.why: engine and room state, buffers and tables past temp[], reached with the data bank $7E or long
parts: the script VM's stack and slots
formula experience, levels and casts (save block $2F52)
HUD popups, alchemy effects, spell emitters, animation and projectile alchemy slots, target selection, damage popups
dialogue ring, script spell, child tasks, the Dog's AI and waypoints, boss segments
entity records, the Boy's and the Dog's among them
map animation, sprite allocation and drawing
spawn records and cycles, sprite CGRAM, map tiles, sprite animation
dynamic VRAM, sprite tiles, palette tables, the tier 1 and 2 tile caches

bank_7f.why: bank $7F: long operands, DMA, or the data bank $7F
